profile_contract.coarse_member: (0,-8) only in the pinned Shieldstral geometry/registry

verification_scope.synthetic: four dense Low/H24 DD/nonDD receipts; private two-stage boundaries with G20->21;19 native receipt-emitting attacks;four CLI cases with19 fresh-verifier controls each

verification_scope.actual_proofs: actual candidate layer00 at T128 on public synthetic input, DD and nonDD; independent integer-oracle parity, fresh verification and tamper rejection
verification_scope.legacy: four R9 golden digests,five identities,four retained R8/R9 full stacks,two retained R12 Shieldstral receipts
